subject: Important Update Regarding Your Account
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about a recent security update to our online platform. In order to enhance the security and privacy of your account, we have implemented a new two-factor authentication process. This will help protect your personal information and ensure that only you have access to your account. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services. Best regards, Customer Support Team
